issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect a static method named acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int) on SealSaloon, but the solution implementation provides a static method named receiveDelivery(String, int, int). This naming mismatch (acceptSupplyDelivery vs. receiveDelivery) will confuse students and may cause tests or starter code examples (Main.java) to not match the solution implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Either rename the solution method receiveDelivery to acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity) (keeping the same behavior), or add a static wrapper acceptSupplyDelivery that delegates to receiveDelivery. Also update any example calls (e.g., Main.java) to match the chosen method name.
